# Quick Start — Salesforce + Devin + Flosum in less than 60 minutes

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-quickstart>. Author: **Maurício Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-04-22 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## In short

A guided way out of **zero to the configured repository**, with the first written specification and **Devin running in your Salesforce context** in less than an hour — already within a governed treadmill.

- **Repository configured** — Salesforce metadata in Git.
- **Written Spec** — the first behavior described as the source of truth.
- **Devin running** — agent operating in its context against spec.
- **Deploy ruled** — promotion with Flosum governance from day one.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How long does the quick start take?**

Less than 60 minutes from scratch to the first ruled deploy: set up the repository, write the first specification and have Devin running in your Salesforce context.

**What do I need before I start?**

Access to org Salesforce, Git repository and Devin and Flosum credentials. Quick start covers the initial configuration and the first example spec.

**Is the result safe for production?**

The flow is already governed: the deploy passes through Flosum's treadmill with approvals and validation. The quick start has established this trail since the first delivery, avoiding the untraceable manual deploy.
